data.text: Temperature is the degree of hotness or coldness of a substance.
The main scales to measure temperature are Celsius and Fahrenheit.
The instrument used to measure temperature is called a thermometer.
The temperature at which water boils is 100°C or 212°F.
The temperature at which water freezes is 0°C or 32°F.
The normal body temperature is 37°C or 98.6°F.
When two things come close together, heat will be transferred from the hotter one to the cooler one, until they reach exactly the same temperature.
